column2: WASTE MAPPING — Every Waste Stream Your Business Produces
Step 1: List every type of waste your business generates. Be honest — include waste you are unsure how to handle. This map is the foundation for everything else in this toolkit.
For each waste type your business produces, fill in all columns. Estimate if exact figures are unknown — your expert can help refine these. Add rows for any waste types not listed.
SECTION B — CURRENT WASTE COST ESTIMATE
Estimate what your business currently spends on waste disposal. Most businesses are surprised by this number.
Waste bags, bins, and separation equipment
Food waste disposal or composting fees
Fines or penalties received in past 12 months

💡  Key insight: Businesses that track waste costs for the first time typically discover they are spending 20–40% more than expected. This number becomes your baseline — every improvement you make reduces it.
